name: basic
note: Common tools in board format 1, with an arrow bound to two shapes.

name: protection
note: A cover and the three pixel effects with their strengths.

name: image
note: A pasted PNG image, rotated and partly transparent.

name: gradients
note: Gradients and labels that follow the stroke need board format 3.

name: all-tools
note: Every drawing tool, with a group, a locked shape, rotation, roughness, fills and labels.

name: stale-bindings
note: An arrow whose start is away from its bound shape and whose end is bound to a missing shape. Opening resolves the start and drops the end binding.

name: higher-schema-than-needed
note: Board format 3 with no labels or gradients is written back as format 1.

name: limits
note: Values at the edges of their allowed ranges.

name: unknown-keys
note: Keys from a future version are ignored and not written back.

name: utf16-little-endian
note: Foundation also reads UTF-16 board files with a byte order mark; the app writes UTF-8.

name: pretty-printed
note: Whitespace and key order do not matter when reading.
